sourceCaption:
Cristiano Ronaldo will continue to play for Portugal after considering retirement from international football following the World Cup 🚨

Ronaldo believes he can help the national team “reach what they want,” and will finish playing when he feels like he’s “not doing anything here” 🙌

(via @beanymansports)
